events.title: Korean Won Record Volatility - Sharpest Swings Since 2009 Financial Crisis
events.summary: Won swings from 1,550 to 1,400s in just over a month. Volatility highest since global financial crisis. Joint US-Japan intervention driving won appreciation. SK hynix ADR dollar conversion adding support.

events.title: Hormuz Crisis Month 6 - Iran-Oman Transit Talks, 6 US Demands
events.summary: Strait blocked since Feb 28. 17 seafarer deaths, 20K mariners stranded. Iran-Oman close to temporary transit agreement. Iran conditions reopening on 6 demands including lifting naval blockade, sanctions, withdrawing forces, paying reparations. Oil peaked $100 in April, now mid-$70s.

events.title: US-Japan First Joint FX Intervention - FIMA Repo Expansion Pushed
events.summary: First-ever coordinated US-Japan FX intervention. Yen hit 40-year low. Bessent pushing Fed to expand FIMA Repo Facility so Japan can borrow dollars using Treasuries as collateral without selling them. BOJ held rate at 1% on July 31, signaling possible hikes from Sept/Oct.

events.title: France Deficit Crisis - EUR 107B H1, Interest Payments +19%, Snowball Effect
events.summary: France H1 deficit EUR 107B (14.4% above budget). Interest payments jumped 19% to EUR 34.5B. Full-year deficit ratio potentially 8%. Le Monde warns of snowball effect. ECB kept rates unchanged at 2.25% on July 23.

events.title: China 10th Quarter of Deflation - Property Wealth Destruction vs US 2008
events.summary: 10 straight quarters of falling prices. S&P expects primary home prices -1.5-2.5% in 2026, secondary -4-5%. Household wealth destruction compared to US 2008 crash. PBOC maintaining moderately loose policy, counter-cyclical support. Currency undervalued 20%+.

events.title: Ebola PHEIC - Largest Recorded DRC Outbreak, 1,801+ Deaths
events.summary: WHO declared PHEIC May 16. Now largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, surpassing 2018-2020. 1,801+ confirmed deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. MSF supporting PARTNERS clinical trial. ECDC update scheduled for Aug 10.

events.title: Private Credit Distress - Growing PIK Payments, Borrower Stress
events.summary: Growing share of private credit borrowers making payments-in-kind (PIK) - rolling interest into balances instead of cash. Fed Boston research confirms trend. Bloomberg reports private credit squeezed by bank refinancings. Not imminent crisis but warning sign.

events.title: Food Crisis Escalation - China Fertilizer Export Bans, FAO Warns of Price Surge
events.summary: China fertilizer export bans (MAP, DAP, TSP) through at least August 2026 tightening global availability. FAO warns fresh food price surge. 49M more impoverished projected for 2026. Super El Nino, fertilizer shortage, cyclosporiasis outbreak converging.

events.title: Fed Hawkish Pivot - Warsh Emphasizing Inflation, Market Pricing Hike
events.summary: Fed left rates unchanged at 3.5-3.75% in July. New Chair Warsh emphasizing inflation without nuance, leading investors to conclude hike coming soon. Bond yields being bid up. 30yr at highest since 2007. Treasury refinancing $125B on Aug 15.

events.title: Argentina-Brazil Diplomatic Crisis, Argentina Country Risk Rising
events.source: PIIE / Rio Times / Buenos Aires Herald (Aug 5-8)
events.summary: Brazil withdrew ambassador from Argentina. Argentina country risk climbed to 451 bps on Aug 7, highest since June. IMF principal payments of ~$3B due from September, doubling in 2027. Decade-long peso destruction of purchasing power.

events.title: UK Fiscal Strain - Rabobank Warns of Autumn Sterling Shock
events.summary: BOE taking gradual approach, Bailey downplaying rate hikes. But Rabobank warns unfunded spending pledges could trigger Sterling sell-off. BofA warns of autumn fiscal shock. UK bonds largely held by foreign investors - capital outflow risk.

events.title: Nigeria 3B Defense Gamble, ISWAP Escalation, Sahel Instability
events.source: Telegraph / ACLED / This Week in Africa (Aug 5-8)
events.summary: Nigeria spending 3B on defense against ISWAP/al-Qaeda linked factions controlling Sahel region. ISWAP increasingly bold, targeting military camps and senior officers. Burkina Faso Traore crackdown on civil society. 20 countries signed new Africa charter.
